SITUATION UPDATE: WEDNESDAY, 25 JUNE 2025 | 10:30 AM
Location: Nairobi & Nyeri Counties
Crowd Density: Level 4 – Dense
Police have deployed tear gas on protesters along Kenyatta Avenue, Tom Mboya Street, Railways, Ronald Ngala Street, and Moi Avenue as of 10:10 AM.
At Central Police Station, officers are actively engaging protesters in running battles and using tear gas.
Running battles between police and protesters have also been reported along Moi Avenue and Muindi Mbingu Street.
In Githurai 45, a group of protesters has started gathering at the Githurai 45 roundabout.
In Nyeri County, protesters have blocked the Nyeri–Nairobi Highway in Karatina town using bonfires, disrupting traffic.

ADVISORY: Exercise heightened caution while in the affected areas.
